_doc: Harms-row audit (cycle 76): every harm outcome across all topics checked by a blind cross-lane for endpoint identity (pooled rows) and absence-correctness (declared-absent rows). Harms had the least prior scrutiny. supports=wrong_endpoint or absent_correct=false => candidate defect, hand-adjudicated vs source below.

adjudication.colchicine-recurrent-pericarditis::24694: DECLINED (bar held): GI intolerance IS reported 9 vs 9 of 120, but the count is written as the WORD "nine", not a digit, so it fails the digit-location verification bar (check_pooled_verified). Declining rather than bending the gate; a principled spelled-out-integer verify enhancement is queued.
adjudication.semaglutide-obesity-mace::37952131: FIXED: AE discontinuation 1461/8803 vs 718/8801 (digits, %-corroborated); was wrongly absent (verified_arms added, gate-verified).
adjudication.corticosteroids-covid19-mortality::32876: CORRECT DECLINE: 3-arm trial (fixed-dose/shock-dependent/no-hydrocortisone); no single pre-specified arm (multi-arm policy).
adjudication.finerenone-ckd-t2d-renal::26325557: CORRECT DECLINE: ARTS dose-ranging (multiple finerenone dose arms); multi-dose policy.
adjudication.omega3-cardiovascular-events::30415628: CORRECT DECLINE: REDUCE-IT AF 3.1% vs 2.1% and bleeding 2.7% vs 2.1% are PERCENTAGES only, no stated per-arm counts.
adjudication.tocilizumab-covid19-mortality::40232661: CORRECT DECLINE: record is a meta-analysis; states no SAEs — not a primary-trial harm row.
adjudication.tocilizumab-covid19-mortality::34609549: QUEUED: toci+remdesivir vs placebo+remdesivir SAE 128(29.8%) vs 72(33.8%); needs denominator + scope confirmation.
adjudication.colchicine-postop-af::32720823: QUEUED (borderline): diarrhoea 2 vs 2 and discontinuation 1 vs 1 are stated, but denominators are only inferable from the POAF % (16.1%); inferred-denominator, null counts, low value.
adjudication.semaglutide-obesity-weight::42575111: ALREADY FIXED (cycle 76): correctly declared absent now (checker confirms absent_correct=true).
